items.title: ESP32 Bit Pirate: Bridging Modern Microcontrollers and Browser-Based Hardware Debugging
items.blurb: ESP32 Bit Pirate project integrates multi-protocol debugging within a browser environment using HTML5 APIs. It enables users to install firmware and interact with microcontrollers like the ESP32-S3 directly from the browser.

items.title: AWS Elemental Inference now generates contextual metadata from live video in real time
items.blurb: AWS Elemental Inference now generates contextual metadata from live video streams in real time, using AI to produce scene-level intelligence without custom machine learning infrastructure.

items.title: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now offers Yield Optimization to automatically fill ad breaks with Amazon Ads demand
items.blurb: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now offers Yield Optimization, a new capability that automatically monetizes unused ad inventory with Amazon Ads demand during server-side ad insertion (SSAI) for livestreams.

items.title: AWS Elemental MediaLive adds support for A/B forensic watermarking
items.blurb: AWS Elemental MediaLive now supports A/B forensic watermarking, enabling content owners to trace the source of unauthorized redistribution of live video content.

items.title: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now supports Low-Latency HLS ad insertion
items.blurb: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now supports Low-Latency HTTP Live Streaming (LL-HLS) ad insertion using HLS Interstitials.

items.title: AWS Storage Gateway now supports FIPS-compliant private connectivity for Amazon S3 File Gateway
items.blurb: AWS Storage Gateway now supports FIPS 140-3 validated endpoints over AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3 File Gateway. Previously, FIPS endpoints for File Gateway were available only over the public internet.

items.title: AWS Elemental introduces Dynamic Multiview for live video
items.blurb: AWS Elemental MediaPackage now offers Dynamic Multiview, a server-side capability that composes multiple live video sources into viewer-selected tiled layouts on demand.
